rationale: Retain one American Roads platform, retire CVC DIF and DIF Infrastructure V after John Laing's completed 2026 acquisition, and add John Laing as the sole current 100% owner. John Laing's live portfolio page and its April 28, 2026 financial-close announcement supersede the stale pending-sale treatment. The precise legal consummation date and buyer SPV are not publicly disclosed, so those details are not inferred.

CVC DIF identified John Laing as buyer and DIF Infrastructure V as the selling fund
DIF Infrastructure V's subsidiary completed the 100% acquisition on July 16, 2018

companyFieldUpdates.description: American Roads owns and operates four tolled transportation assets: the American side of the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel and three Alabama toll bridges. The platform serves passenger and commercial traffic and John Laing reports approximately seven million annual trips. DIF Infrastructure V acquired 100% of American Roads in July 2018. CVC DIF signed the sale to John Laing in February 2026, and John Laing announced financial close on April 28, 2026 and now reports 100% ownership. The exact legal closing date and acquiring SPV are not publicly disclosed. The Foley Beach Express Bridge exited the platform in May 2024 and is not a current asset. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
